boundary_note: Bounded first pass for all six frozen records in the Northern Virginia Campaign. Preserve per-engagement dates, including the adjoining August 22–25 and 25–27 intervals and the separate August 28 Thoroughfare Gap and August 28–30 Manassas records; VA024 is a frozen aggregate-operation record. The live NPS campaign heading does not replace any battle interval. Opening personnel and exact effective command boundaries remain unresolved. Draft claims do not alter model inputs.

claims.rationale: No inspected return establishes matched personnel at a common opening boundary. Imported numerical estimates remain unchanged; this pass does not validate them as simultaneous opening forces.

claims.value: The frozen and live force fields read 24,898 total (US 8,030; CS 16,868). Ropes says Banks's corps present did not reach 8,000 of all arms and puts Jackson's three divisions between 20,000 and 25,000, probably nearer the latter. The NPS narrative says Jackson went to Gordonsville with 14,000 before A. P. Hill joined.
claims.rationale: The Confederate figures differ and describe different moments and scopes; none is adopted as a matched opening population. Shared NPS/CWSAC provenance is not independent corroboration.

claims.value: Ropes prints the order Banks received: move to the front, assume command, deploy skirmishers if the enemy advanced and attack him as he approached, to be reinforced. Ropes argues Pope did not intend a battle before concentration; Banks read the order as authority to attack.
claims.rationale: The order's meaning is disputed in the source itself; the transcription is Ropes's reproduction of a staff officer's written version, not an inspected original.

claims.rationale: Retain the original result and engagement interval; later movements and campaign contribution are different measures. No new probabilities or individual causal credit. Ropes's explanation is an attributed interpretation, not an estimated causal effect.

claims.value: The frozen casualty text reads 2,707 total (US 1,400; CS 1,307); the live NPS field reads 3900 total (US 2500; CS 1400;). Ropes gives the Union loss as 1,661 killed and wounded and 723 missing, total 2,393 (the components sum to 2,384), and Jackson's reported 1,314.
claims.rationale: Original casualty returns were not inspected; preserve totals, categories, cutoffs and differences. No canonical reconciliation or casualty-based opening count; related actions must not be added without resolving population overlap. Ropes's Union total and components disagree in the OCR; print was not checked.

open_questions: Original orders, returns and casualty reconciliation remain deferred; the meaning of the order Banks received is disputed in the source.

NPS/CWSAC is one family; Ropes is one retrospective history written from the Federal standpoint by a civilian author. Reports and despatches quoted inside Ropes are not additional independently inspected families.
No automatic commander attribution, causal campaign score, morale/readiness number or battle/campaign double counting.
